description: This file provides an implementation of the ClientAddressReadPlatformService interface, primarily responsible for retrieving client address configuration data from a database within the Fineract platform. It includes a RowMapper implementation for mapping SQL result sets to ClientAddressData objects and a method for querying address configuration based on entity type.

classes.name: ClientAddressReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implements the service for reading client address configuration data from the database.

classes.name: ClientAddrMapper
classes.description: A RowMapper implementation that maps SQL query results to ClientAddressData objects.

methods.name: retrieveClientAddrConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves client address configuration data filtered by entity type.
